description: Carry a sealed parcel out through the Threshold and Threshold East to a drop on Castoff Walk. Don't shake it, don't open it, don't ask. 15₵.
name: Parcel Run

objectives.emote: {who} shoulders the parcel through the Threshold, very carefully not looking inside it.
{who} keeps the parcel moving through Threshold East, doing their best to ignore the funny smell coming from it.

objectives.desc: Drop the parcel on Castoff Walk
objectives.emote: {who} sets the parcel down on Castoff Walk and steps back fast, like it might go off.
